name: Robo Trader
about: Node JS backend that monitored the prices of cryptocurrencies and searched for trends. Could place 'paper' trades to mimic trading. Built a React JS front end to monitor the system.

name: Brisk CMS
about: Developed for use in websites I build for clients, Brisk CMS works as a bridge between a very light CMS that requires technical expertiese, and a more heavy-weight CMS. Perfect for the small businesses that use it.

name: AJAX in HTML
about: A front-end library that allows your HTML to GET and POST data to your server, all with ZERO JavaScript. Completley backend agnostic.

name: Teleparty Link Share
about: Chrome Extension designed to work in tandem with the Teleparty/Netflix Party extension. Lets users share the join links that are generated.

name: Headless CMS
about: Simple and robust open-source CMS, complete with client side routing. Perfect for fast, static websites.
